claim: The NXC menu-test harness needs the z80 Python package, which a shared virtual environment may lack, so run the tests from an environment that has it.

evidence.text: The shared venv has no z80 package, so the nxc repo's menu tests ran from a private venv.
The nxc harness needs the z80 package; on the owner's PC only one Python version (3.13) has it.
